user.title: Add group
user.description: A group holds instruments. A portfolio adds up what is held; a watchlist is only watched and counts in no sum. Instruments are added to it afterwards, with **Add instrument**.

data_description.benchmark: For a portfolio: the index its performance is set beside on the card. Choose one, or type any symbol of Yahoo Finance. Empty compares with none.

settings.title: Market Ticker Ultra
settings.description: Quotes for stocks, funds, indices, commodities, currencies and coins from public sources - no account, no API key. Instruments are added afterwards, one by one, with **Add instrument** on the integration's page.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the quotes are fetched while a market is open. While all markets are closed, they are fetched every 30 minutes at most.
data_description.logos: Show each instrument with its logo on the card. The logos are loaded by the browser from Elbstream, which is credited for them - "Logos by Elbstream" - in the card's editor and in the README. Switched off, the card shows initials, and your own uploaded logos.
data_description.base_currency: The currency all positions are added up in, as a three-letter code - EUR, USD, CHF. Positions in other currencies are converted at the European Central Bank's daily reference rate.
data_description.sources: Where quotes may come from. A source that is switched off is not asked: the search finds nothing there, and an instrument that was added from it is quoted by another source where one lists the same instrument, and keeps its last quote otherwise.

error.invalid_currency: Three letters, such as EUR or USD.
error.no_source: At least one source is needed.
error.invalid_benchmark: Yahoo Finance has no price series for this symbol.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the quotes are fetched while a market is open. While all markets are closed, they are fetched every 30 minutes at most.
data_description.base_currency: The currency all positions are added up in, as a three-letter code - EUR, USD, CHF. Positions in other currencies are converted at the European Central Bank's daily reference rate.
data_description.logos: Show each instrument with its logo on the card. The logos are loaded by the browser from Elbstream, which is credited for them - "Logos by Elbstream" - in the card's editor and in the README. Switched off, the card shows initials, and your own uploaded logos.

data_description.sources: Where quotes may come from. A source that is switched off is not asked: the search finds nothing there, and an instrument that was added from it is quoted by another source where one lists the same instrument, and keeps its last quote otherwise.
data_description.news_google: Also searches Google News for an instrument's name. It finds more headlines than Yahoo Finance, and some that are about something else.

alert_targets.title: Price alerts: recipients
alert_targets.description: Who is told when a price alert comes on. Every alert also fires the event market_ticker_ultra_alert, for automations.

data_description.alert_persistent: Also puts a notification into Home Assistant itself when a price alert comes on.
data_description.alert_notify: The notify entities that get a message when a price alert comes on - a phone with the Companion App, for one.
data_description.alert_services: Services such as notify.whatsapp or notify.mail, for messengers and mail. Choose from the list or type a name.
data_description.alert_speakers: The speakers a price alert is read out on - a Sonos, for example.
data_description.alert_tts: The text-to-speech voice the alert is spoken with. Empty takes the first there is.
data_description.alert_test: Sends a test message to everybody named above when you save.

alert_texts.title: Price alerts: texts
alert_texts.description: What a price alert says. Variables: {name}, {symbol}, {price} and {limit} (each with its currency), {currency}, {direction} ("at or below" / "at or above") and {change} (the day's change in percent). An empty field takes the default again.

data_description.alert_spoken: What is read out on the speakers.
data_description.alert_test: Sends a test message with these texts to all recipients when you save.

group.title: Group
group.description: The name of the group, and whether it is a portfolio or a watchlist. In a watchlist the purchases of its instruments are kept but not counted.

data_description.benchmark: For a portfolio: the index its performance is set beside on the card. Choose one, or type any symbol of Yahoo Finance. Empty compares with none.

error.invalid_currency: Three letters, such as EUR or USD.
error.no_source: At least one source is needed.
error.invalid_benchmark: Yahoo Finance has no price series for this symbol.

user.title: Find an instrument
user.description: Search by name, by symbol or by ISIN - a stock, a fund, an index, a commodity, a currency pair or a coin. Every source is asked: Yahoo Finance for nearly everything, Börse Frankfurt for Xetra by ISIN, the ECB's reference rate for a currency pair, Kraken for a coin, gold-api.com for a metal's spot price.

data_description.query: For example: Apple, AAPL, US0378331005, S&P 500, EUR/USD, BTC, gold.

listing.title: Choose the listing
listing.description: Found for "{query}". The same instrument is often listed at several exchanges and sources, in different currencies. Each line ends with the last price there and where it is from; a date behind a price means it is not from today.

data_description.convert: For a listing in another currency: every figure is shown in {base}, at the ECB's reference rate. What you hold is then entered in {base} too.

holding.title: Your holding
holding.description: What you hold of **{name}** - or leave everything empty to only watch it. Further purchases can be added afterwards, under **Edit instrument**.

data_description.quantity: How many shares, units or coins.
data_description.price: What one of them cost, in the currency this listing is quoted in.
data_description.date: Optional. It only decides the order in which purchases and sales are counted.
data_description.fees: Optional. What the purchase or sale cost in fees.
data_description.taxes: Optional. What was paid in taxes on it.

reconfigure.title: {name}
reconfigure.description: {symbol} - purchases entered: {count}; held: {quantity} at an average of {average}; realised: {realized}.

rename.title: Rename instrument
rename.description: The name of {symbol}: what its device and its sensors are called.

venue.title: Change the listing
venue.description: {name} is quoted as {symbol}. Search for it again - by its ISIN or its name - to choose another exchange or source.

venue_listing.title: Choose the new listing
venue_listing.description: Found for "{query}". {name} is quoted there from now on; its name, its purchases, its alerts and its sensors stay. Purchases, sales and price alerts are not converted - in another currency their figures count as that one. Where the currency changes, the long-term statistics of its sensors start afresh.

data_description.convert: For a listing in another currency: every figure is shown in {base}, at the ECB's reference rate.

add_lot.title: Add a purchase
add_lot.description: {name} - entered so far: {count}; held: {quantity} at an average of {average}.

data_description.quantity: How many shares, units or coins were bought.
data_description.price: What one of them cost, in the currency this listing trades in.
data_description.date: Optional. It only decides the order in which purchases and sales are counted.
data_description.fees: Optional. What the purchase cost in fees.
data_description.taxes: Optional. What was paid in taxes on it.

sell_lot.title: Add a sale
sell_lot.description: {name} - entered so far: {count}; held: {quantity} at an average of {average}.

data_description.quantity: How many were sold. They leave the holding at its average price so far.
data_description.price: What one of them brought in, in the currency this listing trades in.
data_description.date: Empty means today. It sets the order in which purchases and sales are counted.
data_description.fees: Optional. What the sale cost in fees.
data_description.taxes: Optional. What was paid in taxes on it.

remove_lots.title: Remove purchases and sales
remove_lots.description: {name}: tick what should go. Removing all of them leaves an instrument that is only watched.

logo.title: Own logo
logo.description: {name}: an image of your own - for an instrument that has no logo, or in place of the one it has. PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to 1 MB; a square image fits best. It is kept in your configuration folder and shown with the logos switched off too.

data_description.remove_logo: Goes back to the logo the instrument has without it. Ignored when a new image is uploaded.

tradingview.title: TradingView link
tradingview.description: The card links the details of {name} to its page at TradingView. **The symbol worked out for {symbol}: {found}.** The field shows the symbol in use. Change it to your own, as TradingView writes it - the exchange, a colon, the ticker, such as NASDAQ:AAPL. Empty goes back to the one worked out; where there is none, the card shows no link.

move.title: Move to another group
move.description: {name}: the group it stands in. In a watchlist its purchases are kept but not counted.

alerts.title: Price alerts
alerts.description: {name}: an alert is on while the price stands at or beyond its limit. Each limit gets a binary sensor; who is told is set in the integration's settings. Leave a field empty for no limit.

color.title: Colour
color.description: {name}: the colour it is drawn in where a card shows a portfolio's shares. Type a value such as #009999 into the search for a colour of your own. Empty, the card gives it one.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: {name} is quoted in {quoted}. Switched on, every figure is shown in {base} instead: the price at the ECB's reference rate of the day, each point of the chart at the rate of its own day. That is not the price it trades at in {base}, and the change includes the currency's. Purchases, sales and price alerts already entered are not converted - their figures count as {base} from then on. Where the currency changes, the long-term statistics of its sensors start afresh.

to_portfolio.title: Into which portfolio?
to_portfolio.description: {name}: with a purchase the instrument moves from the watchlist into a portfolio. Its sensors stay the same.

data_description.name: Only for a new portfolio. Empty names it “Portfolio”.

sold_out.title: Everything sold
sold_out.description: {name}: nothing is held any more. Purchases and sales stay with the instrument, and with them what it has earned ({realized}).

data_description.after_sale: A folder with an arrow moves the instrument to that watchlist.

error.cannot_connect: The source could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.nothing_found: Nothing found. Try another spelling, the symbol or the ISIN.
error.already_configured: This listing has already been added.
error.invalid_lot: Enter a quantity above 0 and a price.
error.logo_wrong_type: Not an image this takes. Use PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG.
error.logo_too_large: The image is larger than 1 MB.
error.invalid_tradingview: Not a TradingView symbol. Write the exchange, a colon and the ticker, such as NASDAQ:AAPL.
error.invalid_color: Choose one of the colours, or type a value such as #009999.
error.group_exists: A group of this name already exists.
error.sell_too_many: That is more than is held.
error.no_rate: The ECB publishes no reference rate for this listing's currency, so it cannot be converted.

source_failing.title: {source} does not answer
source_failing.description:
**{source}** has not answered {count} times in a row. The last reason:

`{reason}`

Its instruments keep their last quotes, each with the time it is from; where another source quotes the same instrument, that one stands in. Nothing needs doing: the quotes come back with the source's next answer, and this repair goes with it.

options.ecb: ECB reference rates - currency pairs, once a day
options.goldapi: gold-api.com - spot prices of gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper
options.yahoo: Yahoo Finance - stocks, funds, indices, futures, currencies, coins
